phase: remaining production-readiness items after tier 1 and tier 2
not_deployed: no change was applied to any running service; the only cluster interaction was a self-cleaning scratch namespace used to test NetworkPolicy enforcement

4_atomic_reindexing.detail: products is now an alias over a timestamped index; a rebuild fills a new index and moves the alias atomically, and is refused if the document count disagrees with the catalog's declared total
4_atomic_reindexing.tests: 8 Elasticsearch integration tests plus 4 rewritten unit tests
4_atomic_reindexing.found: the pre-existing consistency check compared the received pages only against each other, so a truncated catalog pagination would have published a short index as consistent

1_payment_robustness.status: implemented and verified, provider still a mock
1_payment_robustness.detail: charge/refund keyed by idempotency key; lookup added so recovery asks the provider whether a charge happened before cancelling; unreachable provider defers instead of cancelling; refunds issued once and recorded in payment_refund_id
1_payment_robustness.tests: 9 provider tests and 6 workflow reconciliation tests against PostgreSQL
1_payment_robustness.found: the mock's check-then-put let 8 concurrent retries create 8 charges; now an atomic claim

6_reproducible_load_testing.status: harness implemented and self-verified; no application benchmark run
6_reproducible_load_testing.detail: seeded 10k-corpus query sets, declared cold/warm/mixed cache regimes, constant arrival rate, summary manifest with provenance and zero-result counts
6_reproducible_load_testing.tests: ops/testing/load-harness.sh drives k6 against a stub and asserts regime behaviour and that an unreachable target reports 100% failure
6_reproducible_load_testing.found: the hey parser computed its error rate from displayed HTTP statuses only, so dropped requests were invisible; it now counts the error distribution and flags the 1M sample cap

7_point_in_time_recovery.detail: WAL archiving enabled on the Compose PostgreSQL; ops/backup/pitr-drill.sh restores to a chosen instant and proves a table dropped after the target is recovered

9_role_migration.detail: idempotent migration script; 23 checks covering data preservation, DDL by the new owner, and cross-database denial
9_role_migration.found: REASSIGN OWNED fails when the legacy role owns system objects; ownership is now transferred object by object

10_frontend_lint.detail: all 7 pre-existing errors fixed across 5 components; CI now gates the whole frontend

2_alert_delivery.detail: receivers read their destination from mounted secret files, so wiring a pager is a secret change; multi-window burn-rate alerting added (fast 14.4x, slow 6x)
2_alert_delivery.remaining: no destination is configured, so nobody is paged yet

3_slo_measurement.detail: error-budget and latency recording rules added; the load harness can now produce comparable measurements
3_slo_measurement.remaining: no objective has been measured against production traffic, because there is none

8_networkpolicy_enforcement.status: verified as NOT enforced on this cluster
8_networkpolicy_enforcement.detail: ops/testing/networkpolicy-enforcement.sh applied a default-deny policy in a scratch namespace and traffic still flowed
8_networkpolicy_enforcement.consequence: every NetworkPolicy in k8s/ is inert on docker-desktop; pod-to-pod isolation rests on the service tokens alone until an enforcing CNI is installed

5_graded_search_evaluation.status: not done, and not doable without human judgement
5_graded_search_evaluation.detail: the harness, rubric, and query set exist and are tested. What is missing is graded relevance labels, which are human labour. Fabricating them would make every number downstream a lie.

suites.name: Backend unit and API
suites.note: skips are Docker-gated suites run by the scripts below; was 160 before this work began. An earlier figure of 257 was wrong: it was summed from surefire reports that had accumulated without a clean build, including reports for test classes since deleted.

limitations: No graded relevance evaluation exists; queries.v1.json remains AI-authored and unjudged.
No load benchmark was run against the application: the harness is verified, the system is not measured.
Alertmanager has no destination configured, so no alert reaches a human yet.
NetworkPolicy is not enforced on the local cluster; the manifests are inert there.
The payment provider is still a mock with in-process memory and no settlement reconciliation.
WAL archiving has no retention policy; the archive grows without bound.
Nothing was deployed, and no SLO has been measured against real traffic.
